newsitem.title: USA: Cameco to buy uranium holdings.
newsitem.headline: Cameco to buy uranium holdings.

text.p: Cameco Corp said on Monday it entered into a comprehensive agreement to buy the North American uraniam holdings of a unit of Britain's state-owned nuclear company Magnox Electric Plc for $105 million in cash.

The company said it would buy 100 percent of the outstanding shares of Power Resources Inc, a U.S. uranium mining company and 100 percent of the outstanding shares of Central Electricity Generating Board Exploration (Canada) Ltd, a company mostly involved in Canadian uranium exploration.
The purchase, which was subject to regulatory approval, would add over one million pounds U308 to Cameco's annual production, the company said.

It would increase Cameco's base of reserves and resources by adding 37 million pounds or 10 percent of recoverable uranium reserves and another 85 million pounds or 40 percent within the resource category, Cameco said.
Cameco said it would also gain interest in several well- located exploration projects in Canada.

"This acquisition enhances our uranium reserve base and production capability and gives us access to exceptional operating experience," said Cameco Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer Bernard Michel. The company said it would also gain access to knowledge of in-situ leach technology, a low-cost method of extracting uranium from certain types of deposits.
Power Resources was one of the largest uranium producers in the United States, Cameco said.
